# Platforms

What each network accepts. The server enforces every limit here and answers `invalid` with the reason, so use this to shape a post before sending rather than after. `platform` values are what `list_channels` / `GET /connected-accounts` return.

| Platform | `platform` | Text | Threads | Media per item | Polls |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| X | `twitter` | 280 chars | yes | 4 | yes |
| Bluesky | `bluesky` | 300 graphemes | yes | 4 | no |
| LinkedIn | `linkedin_personal` | 3000 chars | no | 9 | no |
| LinkedIn Page | `linkedin_page` | 3000 chars | no | 9 | no |
| Mastodon | `mastodon` | 500 chars | yes | 4 | yes |
| Discord | `discord` | 2000 chars | no | 10 | no |
| Instagram | `instagram` | 2200 chars | no | 10 | no |
| TikTok | `tiktok` | 2200 chars | no | 35 | no |
| Threads | `threads` | 500 chars | yes | 10 | no |
| Facebook Page | `facebook_page` | 63206 chars | no | 10 | no |
| Slack | `slack` | 40000 chars | no | 10 | no |

### X (`twitter`)

- **Text:** 280 chars; 25000 with X Premium
- **Threads:** yes
- **Media:** up to 4 per item; images to 4.8 MB; video to 488.3 MB, 140s; GIFs to 14.3 MB
- **MIME types:** `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`, `video/mp4`
- **Polls:** 2 to 4 options of 25 chars, 5 to 10080 minutes
- **Quote posts:** yes · **Replies to a URL:** yes · **Link previews:** yes
- **`replySettings`:** `everyone`, `following`, `mentionedUsers`, `subscribers`, `verified`
- **Auto-engagement:** comment, like, repost

## Per-channel fields on a post

Each entry in `accounts` can carry, besides `items`:

- `isSynced`: whether this channel shares the group's common body. Set it explicitly.
- `scheduledAt`: a per-channel fire time, to stagger one post across networks.
- `replySettings`: who may reply, from the platform's list above.
- `postFormat`: the container, where the platform offers a choice.
- `platformOptions`: network-specific settings, keyed by platform:

  - `tiktok`: object
    - `title`: string (max length 2200)
    - `privacyLevel`: one of `"PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE"` | `"MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS"` | `"FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR"` | `"SELF_ONLY"`
    - `disableComment`: boolean
    - `disableDuet`: boolean
    - `disableStitch`: boolean
    - `brandOrganicToggle`: boolean
    - `brandContentToggle`: boolean
    - `isAigc`: boolean
    - `videoCoverTimestampMs`: integer (min 0, max 9007199254740991)
    - `photoCoverIndex`: integer (min 0, max 9007199254740991)
    - `autoAddMusic`: boolean
  - `threads`: object
    - `shareToInstagram`: boolean
